Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.feed

Class RomeFeedHarvester

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.feed.RomeFeedHarvester
All Implemented Interfaces:
ArticleHarvestingPort
@Component public class RomeFeedHarvester extends Object implements ArticleHarvestingPort
Infrastructure adapter that implements ArticleHarvestingPort using the Rome RSS/Atom library.

Iterates over all configured FeedSourceConfig entries, fetches each feed via Rome's SyndFeedInput, maps each SyndEntry to a NewsArticle domain record, and returns a flat list for downstream AI relevance scoring and summarization.

Each harvested NewsArticle is stamped with the topicId, sourceName, sourceTier, and sourceWeight from its FeedSourceConfig, ensuring that all articles and newsletter output can be filtered by topic throughout the pipeline.

Connection and read timeouts are intentionally kept short (10 s / 15 s) to avoid blocking the scheduler thread pool on slow or unavailable feeds. Failed feeds are logged and skipped — a single bad feed never aborts the full harvest cycle.

    • harvestAll

      public List<NewsArticle> harvestAll()
      Harvests all configured RSS/Atom feeds and returns a flat list of NewsArticle domain records.

      Each article's sourceWeight is pre-populated from the feed's FeedSourceConfig.baseWeight() so the AI scoring layer can use it as a prior.

      Specified by:

      Returns:
      flat, unordered list of harvested articles (never null)
